content.text:
**No concrete blocker found in candidate0073.** The interval correction matches the existing domain mapping, preserves coarse delta scaling and numeric values, and has independent regression coverage.

- **Correct arithmetic:** [midi_value_domain.lua:4](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/devices/midi_value_domain.lua:4) adds exactly one interval when Off lies outside the active range. Thus `0…127` plus Off requires `1/128`. Sparse Off gaps likewise count as one position. This matches the mapping already introduced in commit `ff8c27f`; an outside-Off singleton correctly gets quantum `1`.

- **Compatibility:** All three editor branches use the helper at [channel_edit_page_ui.lua:645](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/pages/channel_edit_page/channel_edit_page_ui.lua:645). Existing coarse multipliers remain at line 665, and the original quantum is restored at line 760. Completed [NRPN016 evidence](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-runs/a83aa3c465b2449f966895da9f18ac5d/results.json) confirms coarse/fine output `128,257,256,255,254,253` and clean CC **96**; completed 017/018 receipts also retain 96.

- **Tests are not circular:** [test_patch_param_domain.lua:67](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/test_patch_param_domain.lua:67) enumerates expected integers independently of the mapping. [The native sweep:400](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/trig_parameter_interactions.py:400) compares actual MIDI against literal values, including clamp and Off reentry; both completed configured/generic receipts pass. The empty-policy addition is confined to the fixture.

- **Remaining focused coverage gap:** The standalone sweep directly sets quantum, bypassing UI branch selection, coarse acceleration and restoration. Sparse/custom-Off/singleton native editor behavior therefore remains unproven; coarse scaling still uses numeric span, including any Off gap. A sparse/custom-Off UI case switching fine/coarse would add useful coverage. This is a coverage limitation, not an established 0073 defect.

**CONFIDENCE: High for this focused correction.** Real-time and pending-cancellation cases remain unverified; I did not inspect or poll the active matrix, execute tests, edit files or launch agents.
